title: What the Survey Missed
tagline: Survey fixed synthetic sites and separate detection from occupancy
hub_blurb: Survey fixed synthetic sites across repeated rounds and discover why fewer sightings do not by themselves prove lower occupancy.
card_blurb: Run a reproducible wildlife-survey scenario, inspect detection histories, and learn why fewer sightings do not by themselves prove lower occupancy.
description: **What the Survey Missed** — an offline synthetic occupancy investigation. Students survey two fixed groups of 24 sites across up to three rounds, distinguish observations from occupancy, inspect a transparent likelihood view, and reveal the generating model only after explaining the evidence.
